entities.name: Maka Bochorishvili
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maka Bochorishvili is a Georgian diplomat and Georgian Dream politician. She has been a member of Parliament of Georgia since 2020, and has served as the Minister of Foreign Affairs since November 2024.
